outcome: Make the behavioral evaluation suite executable and gradable so that per-case execution status becomes evidence instead of a specification claim.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded runner materializes any specified case into an isolated synthetic fixture repository and verifies the pinned fixture SHA-256 before use.
Filesystem-decidable and transcript-decidable hard assertions are graded mechanically without human judgement.
An assertion with no decidable method is reported as incomplete and never as pass.
A case passes only when every hard assertion passes on every required repeat.
The aggregate output states how many of the specified cases were attempted and marks the remainder as specification only.
Recorded results contain aggregates and sanitized pointers only, never raw transcripts or credentials.
The documented case count matches the suite contents.

in: Add scripts/run_evaluation.py with materialize, grade and aggregate subcommands.
Correct the documented case count in docs/harness/evaluation-suite.md from 27 to 32 and describe the v7 cases.
Document the grading methods and the incomplete-over-pass rule.
out: Execute the suite against any live model as part of this task.
Claim a behavioral result for any case.
Touch a real repository, network target or external service.

triggers: A grader that guesses a verdict would manufacture false evidence in a project whose central claim is evidence quality.
Storing raw transcripts in results could leak prompts or sensitive content.

gates.reason: A tool that decides pass and fail states is regression sensitive and needs positive and negative coverage.
The tool materializes repositories, reads transcripts and writes results, so leakage and path handling are in scope.
The change alters how execution status of the behavioral suite is claimed in released documentation.
One leaf tool plus a documentation correction; no boundary or contract change.
No user interface surface is added or modified.
No external data source, schema ownership or persistence path is involved.
No model, network or paid resource is consumed by the tool itself.
The runner is host neutral and invokes no model.

assumptions: The agent host is invoked by the operator outside this runner, so the runner stays host-neutral.
Network isolation is enforced by the operator's environment and recorded as a manual verdict.
missing_information: No accepted baseline exists yet, so cost and latency thresholds cannot be compared.

documentation_impact.reason: The suite gains an execution procedure and a grading contract that operators must follow.

manual_checks: Materialize H4-01, run a clean no-write scenario and confirm the three decidable assertions pass.
Repeat with a scenario that writes to the fixture and confirm the run fails.
Confirm an undecidable assertion stays incomplete until a manual verdict is recorded.
Confirm the aggregate refuses to pass a case with fewer than the required repeats.
evidence: Positive, negative, manual-verdict and repeat-shortfall scenarios were exercised locally against synthetic fixtures.

not_validated.reason: This task delivers the runner. Executing the suite against a host is the operator's next action and is tracked as REL-01.
The suite compares candidates against an accepted baseline and no baseline run exists yet.

not_validated.area: network isolation of the agent host
not_validated.reason: Isolation is enforced by the operator environment and cannot be proven by the runner.

next_action: Operator runs H4-01, H4-09 and H5-18 against one host for three repeats each and commits the resulting evaluation-run.json.
